name: Recipient resolution
mission: Resolve free-text recipient input to candidate legal entities
allowed_decisions: propose ranked candidates with match basis
prohibited_actions: bind recipient (donor confirms or EIN exact match D); approve
escalation_conditions: no candidate above floor; multiple near-equal candidates; candidate has foreign or fiscal-sponsor indicators
evidence_requirements: AgentRun with candidates and sources read
evaluation_datasets: public Schedule I recipient names vs EINs; look-alike and homoglyph adversarial set
failure_detection: donor rejection rate of top candidate; override rate drift
acceptance_targets_design: top-1 correct >= design target set in Phase 3; zero bindings without donor confirmation (invariant)

name: Benefit and private-benefit risk flagger
mission: Flag recommendations with indicators of more-than-incidental benefit (tickets tuition pledges memberships related parties)
data_access: recommendation purpose text (untrusted); relationships; prior grants
prohibited_actions: clear any flag; approve or decline
escalation_conditions: any flag raised routes to grants compliance case
evidence_requirements: AgentRun; flag reason with quoted evidence spans
evaluation_datasets: Notice 2017-73 patterns; synthetic benefit cases; adversarial purpose text injection
failure_detection: flag-rate drift both directions; human override rate
rollback_compensation: flag is advisory; no compensation needed; missed-flag discovered later -> post-grant review case
monitoring: recall on golden set; queue SLA
acceptance_targets_design: recall floor prioritized; precision floor keeps queue within SLA

name: Sanctions near-match triage
mission: Summarize fuzzy screening hits for the sanctions officer (never clears)
data_access: screening index; party and recipient data
allowed_decisions: attach triage dossier ranking likely-false and likely-true indicators
prohibited_actions: clear or downgrade hit; release hold
escalation_conditions: every potential match goes to sanctions officer regardless of triage
evaluation_datasets: OFAC SDN with transliteration variants; synthetic near-match set
acceptance_targets_design: no hit ever closed without H (invariant); officer time per hit reduced vs baseline (measure)

name: Exception grant dossier preparer
mission: Assemble evidence for non-routine grants (foreign ER fiscal sponsor new org large)
data_access: recipient data; public filings; prior dossiers
prohibited_actions: approve; sign ER agreement; contact recipient as sponsor decision
escalation_conditions: missing source; conflicting sources; adverse media
evidence_requirements: dossier with source provenance per claim
evaluation_datasets: historical Schedule F/I non-standard recipients; expert-labeled dossiers
failure_detection: specialist rework rate; unsupported-claim rate from grounding check
acceptance_targets_design: every claim sourced (grounding 100% design target); specialist time reduction measured not assumed

name: Orphan deposit matcher
prohibited_actions: post contribution; contact donor as decision
escalation_conditions: no proposal above floor after T+1; amount > threshold
evaluation_datasets: historical receipt files (after operations); synthetic orphan set

name: Reconciliation break triage
mission: Classify breaks and propose resolution path
allowed_decisions: propose cause class and next step
escalation_conditions: break above value threshold; aging beyond SLO; unknown class
evaluation_datasets: synthetic break library (timing; fee; corporate action; duplicate; return)
acceptance_targets_design: classification accepted by controller >= target; no ledger writes (invariant)

name: Complex asset dossier
mission: Prepare acceptance analysis for non-cash assets (liabilities liquidity UBTI excess business holdings environmental)
evaluation_datasets: synthetic and anonymized historical gift files; non-cash processor public materials

name: Document extraction
mission: Extract structured fields from appraisals ER reports statements and agreements
allowed_decisions: propose field values with page citations
evaluation_datasets: public form samples (Form 8283 qualified appraisal elements); synthetic documents
acceptance_targets_design: field confirm-without-edit rate >= target before any field is auto-suggested

name: Service answer agent
mission: Answer donor and advisor questions from authoritative state and approved policy corpus
authorized_tools: read:account projections (scoped to requester);read:approved answer corpus;send:grounded reply;open:case
data_access: requester's own account data; policy corpus
allowed_decisions: send grounded factual answers; open cases
prohibited_actions: tax/legal advice; commit to outcomes; goodwill credits; any write
escalation_conditions: complaint; dispute; tax advice request; low grounding; distress signals
evidence_requirements: conversation log with citations and state snapshot
evaluation_datasets: synthetic donor question set; adversarial social engineering set
failure_detection: grounding failures; QA sampling; complaint rate
rollback_compensation: switch to human queue; correct and notify
acceptance_targets_design: grounding check pass 100% for sent replies (validator blocks otherwise); QA sample pass >= target

name: Advisor copilot
mission: Help advisors prepare recommendations contributions and reports for their clients
prohibited_actions: submit on own; investment advice to donors; access non-client accounts

name: Donor discovery and education
mission: Help donors articulate goals and explore recipients with disclosed criteria and evidence grades
data_access: donor-provided goals (with consent); public recipient data
prohibited_actions: steer to sponsor-favored recipients; paid placement; tax advice
evaluation_datasets: fairness test sets by recipient segment (small; local; faith; international)
acceptance_targets_design: no segment systematically excluded (audit) — threshold set by Philanthropic Intelligence head

name: Post-grant ER tracker
mission: Track expenditure responsibility reports and restricted-grant follow-ups
allowed_decisions: send reminders; open cases on lateness
escalation_conditions: report overdue past policy; report content raises diversion indicators
runs_per_outcome_assumption: few per ER grant per year

name: Policy drafting and impact analysis
mission: Draft policy rule changes from counsel's instructions and run impact analysis via back-test tool
escalation_conditions: always to policy owner and change board
evaluation_datasets: historical decision corpus; seeded policy-regression cases
failure_detection: backtest diffs not explained; reviewer rejection

name: Regulatory change monitor
mission: Watch Federal Register IRS state sources and summarize relevance to obligation register
prohibited_actions: change obligations; treat proposed rules as current law
escalation_conditions: any item tagged current law or effective-date change
evaluation_datasets: historical regulatory changes (e.g. 2023 proposed §4966 regs; OBBBA 2025) replay
acceptance_targets_design: current-vs-proposed misclassification zero on replay set

name: SOC report analyzer
mission: Extract exceptions scope and complementary user entity controls from vendor SOC reports
evaluation_datasets: public SOC report structure; synthetic reports

name: Improvement recommendation agent
mission: Find work to eliminate (not just accelerate) from telemetry and propose hypotheses for simulation
prohibited_actions: deploy changes; weaken controls; change agent permissions
escalation_conditions: any proposal touching controls policy or permissions -> change board
acceptance_targets_design: every proposal classified eliminate/automate/accelerate; zero self-deployed changes (invariant)

name: Undeclared related-party detector
mission: Detect likely undeclared relationships relevant to §4958/§4967 (shared addresses officers entities)
authorized_tools: read:party data;read:recipient officer data (990 Part VII public);flag:raise;propose:relationship
acceptance_targets_design: recall prioritized; privacy review of features

name: Fraud anomaly explainer
mission: Explain fraud-model alerts in plain language for analysts
prohibited_actions: release holds; contact donor as decision

name: Board evidence pack narrator
mission: Draft narrative for board and committee packs from live evidence dashboards
escalation_conditions: any breached control must appear (deterministic check)
